name: Incidence Matrix Isomorphism
description: Translates a graph connectivity problem into a linear algebra problem by representing edges as difference vectors $e_u - e_v$ and path connectivity as linear spans. Models relying on surface patterns will misidentify the domain and attempt to use matrix operations or Gaussian elimination, leading to TLE or MLE. Models that genuinely reason mathematically will recognize that $m=n-1$ difference vectors spanning the space form a tree, and that the linear span condition is isomorphic to finding the minimal connecting subtree.
